title: eludite.agents.switch input
description: Show another session in the Agents window, as a click on a row of its history list does. A live session shows at once and keeps running. A stored one shows its transcript from Eludite's record; when the agent that owns it is in the registry and advertises ACP `loadSession`, the agent is started and `session/load` resumes it (the state is `ready` after the load, and the next prompt continues the conversation); otherwise the transcript says the agent cannot resume it and the prompt box is disabled (eludite.agents.start with `restart: true` then begins a new session with the same agent). Answers the state (agents-state.output.json).
